'''Tessa Wylden''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Accountant/Legends|accountant]] who worked for the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] crime syndicate at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1.5 years ABY]], [[Garm Bel Iblis/Legends|Garm Bel Iblis]]' aide [[Irenez (Twi'lek)|Irenez]] was involved in fighting Black Sun on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. She had identified Wylden as one of Black Sun's accountants on the planet and had her under surveillance for some time. Irenez then paid a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to track down Wylden and capture her. When the spacer found her, he killed the men guarding her and brought Wylden to Irenez in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet]].

Wylden was questioned and revealed much information about Black Sun and its money streams. Her information revealed that the [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Skazz]] had been hired to kill the head of [[Corellian Security Force|CorSec]] and that the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] had been selling weapons to Black Sun.

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:SlicerFemTemplate.jpg|250px|thumb|Possible depictions of Tesa Wylden]]
[[File:SlicerMaleTemplate.jpg|250px|thumb|Randomly generated male depictions, deemed non-canon in Legends continuity]]
Tessa Wylden was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Character]] (NPC) in [[Sony]] Online Entertainment's [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. She was part of a mission given out by Irenez on Corellia that required the player to search out a place outside the city, kill the guards and then lead Wylden back to Irenez. In 2005 the NPCs Garm Bel Iblis and Irenez were removed from the game and the quest involving Wylden was therefore no longer available.

Due to the way such quests were designed by the developers, the appearance, gender and species of the NPC are different each time a player runs the mission. Therefore there's no canonical description of the character's look and species, while her sex is mentioned by Irenez and therefore canon.
